description: Production deploy: runs the root-owned csa-prod-deploy entry script as the ubuntu user. Published in AWS as csa-production-deploy.

sha.description: Full 40 character lowercase commit sha on main.

migrations.description: Comma-separated four-digit migration numbers, or empty.

hostDigest.description: 12 character lowercase hex digest of the host file, required for apply, empty for plan.

runCommand: exec runuser -u ubuntu -- /usr/local/sbin/csa-prod-deploy "{{ action }}" "{{ sha }}" "{{ migrations }}" "{{ hostDigest }}"
